department: Graduate School of Biomedical Sciences — Biomedical Sciences Ph.D. Programs

deadline.value: Priority/early-review deadline is December 1, 2026 and final application deadline is January 1, 2027 for July 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: The deadline for submitting your application to begin school in July 2027 is Jan. 1, 2027. Applications received by Dec. 1, 2026 will be considered for early review and are strongly encouraged.

also.quote: Jan. 1 - Final Application deadline. Late applications will be considered on a space-available basis.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required for GSBS biomedical Ph.D. programs (optional only if applying to Quantitative & Computational Biosciences).
gre_general.quote: The GRE is no longer required by any of the graduate school Ph.D. programs. If you are applying to the Neuroscience or Quantitative & Computational Biosciences programs, GRE scores are optional, but not required.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for the biomedical sciences, and GSBS does not require the GRE.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is no longer required by any of the graduate school Ph.D. programs.

also.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants do not need a research supervisor (PI) before applying; admitted students complete three to five lab rotations in their first year.
supervisor.quote: Do I need to find a research supervisor (PI) prior to applying? | No, this is not required. During your first year in the program, you will have three to five lab rotations to assist you with the lab selection process.

funding.value: All GSBS Ph.D. students receive a $40,000 annual stipend (AY 2025-26 and 2026-27), full tuition remission ($22,000/yr), facilities fee coverage, and student-only medical/dental health insurance with no teaching requirement.
funding.quote: Our Ph.D. students receive a competitive stipend, full tuition remission and individual health insurance at no cost to the student. | Stipend: | $40,000 for Academic Year 2025-26 | $40,000 for Academic Year 2026-27 | In addition to the stipend above, the graduate school pays for your health insurance ($7,104.00) as well as tuition ($22,000) and facilities fee ($5,000) each year. | Therefore, teaching is not a requirement for earning a stipend.

entry_route.value: Applicants may apply directly with a bachelor’s degree (or higher); official transcripts are required from all institutions where a degree (Associate’s, Bachelor’s, or Graduate) was earned.
entry_route.quote: Official transcripts are required from every institution where you have earned a degree (Associate's, Bachelor's, and Graduate level).

also.quote: Baccalaureate degree (or higher) earned from a regionally accredited U.S. institution or at an institution at which English is the medium of instruction in the following countries.

notes: Covers BCM GSBS biomedical Ph.D. programs: Cancer & Cell Biology; Chemical, Physical & Structural Biology; Development, Disease Models & Therapeutics; Genetics & Genomics; Immunology & Microbiology; and Quantitative & Computational Biosciences (where GRE scores are optional). Applicants may list first- and second-choice GSBS programs on one fee-free application.
